title: Ocean's 14 will not start filming until late 2027, says Brad Pitt
summary: George Clooney, Julia Roberts and Matt Damon are expected to return.
body:
Brad Pitt says Ocean's 14 will not begin filming until late 2027. He told Variety at the premiere of his new film on 16 November that shooting would start "sometime late next year".

Filming had previously been expected to begin sooner.

Who is involved

Pitt, George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon and Don Cheadle are expected to return. David Leitch is set to direct from a script by Grant Heslov and Clooney, which Pitt praised.

No release date has been announced. Pitt also said he would like to make a sequel to his racing film F1.

Sources: Variety, NewsBytes.
